operation.description:
This deletes a single autolink reference by ID that was configured for the given repository.

Information about autolinks are only available to repository administrators.
operation.summary: Delete an autolink reference from a repository

#/components/parameters/autolink-id.description: The unique identifier of the autolink.
#/components/parameters/autolink-id.name: autolink_id

#/components/parameters/owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/owner.name: owner

#/components/parameters/repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/repo.name: repo
